The '''S-13 Sting''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] which performed in scout roles. The culmination of [[Tandankin shipyards]]' line of experimental designs, its array of offensive, defensive and maneuvering capabilities surpassed most other known scout craft, so much so that it was barely classified as a scout with its basic suite of sensor and communication equipment.<ref name="GS" />
